notes.title: A new game and a little about the upcoming DLC.
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/982e3cc81336a27d639cf8d47d38f1f81fd63d79.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]She goes to the new home of her... ahem... "close people" to say goodbye and finds an old book in the attic, apparently left behind by the previous owners of the house.[/p]
[p]Completely by accident, using this book, she summons a succubus girl with a playful, lewd, and extremely selfish personality. The succubus helps her cure the illness in exchange for the ability to use the heroine's body and experience the pleasures of this world that would otherwise be inaccessible to her.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/cf944148e7968d8bd2cabf7793a2239b0d726099.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]However, such coexistence will not be easy for either of the heroines. The story is built on the conflict between two personalities — the modest and virtuous Angel, and the lewd, depraved, and reckless Nyx.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/619e44799ca05cb00e4c866ab184b06d50b2e020.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]Angel wants revenge on her ex and is ready to become a pop star (with Nyx’s special powers) to destroy him from the top of Olympus, while Nyx just wants to have fun, caring nothing for Angel’s reputation or desires.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/7aad289bd20204da66def3435e886b03ddbe3315.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]In addition, in the house where Angel is temporarily staying, she begins to form "unusual" and sometimes even [b]too[/b] intimate relationships with her close ones. And it's all thanks to Nyx, who could seduce even a dead stone. Will Angel be able to deal with all of this, or will she fall into depravity and debauchery, joining Nyx in her unrestrained lust?[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/e40fcd0b6209e92db0341cee11580ab0dc4ac0a8.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/05323b0f85fb0c11f70efa2646d7e6b5e0509a63.jpg"][/img][/p]
[p]The game has been in development for over two months, and I hope the alpha demo version will be ready in a month. It will include approximately 1,000 renders and just under 50 animations. The graphical part is already complete. Right now, I’m assembling all the content into the game, working on voice acting, selecting music, etc. The demo will cover about 10–15% of the game’s total planned content. That’s too little to release it as a demo or in Early Access on Steam, but enough to get early feedback from players and maybe adjust the development path.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/37e61adccba79887e55cb1ccbad87d71db0413a7.jpg"][/img][/p]
[h3]👉 [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/GPoint"]The demo version will be available to paid subscribers on my Patreon.[/url][/h3]
[p][/p]
[p]Right now, I post development diaries there every week so you can follow the progress of the new game. Go check it out, subscribe for free to stay updated or learn more about the game, or support the development with a paid subscription. I’ll always be grateful for that. Your support really helps me stay focused and avoid procrastination, knowing that the game already has an audience that supports me and whom I can’t let down. Also, paid subscribers receive some bonuses and earlier access to materials.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/67adfa391a7608aadca647e3a810842138c2e94c.gif"][/img][/p]
[p]What else will the game offer besides the story? This game will have many more dialogue options, choices, and [b]free roaming[/b] across locations that won't be empty. In each act, in every room and nook available for exploration, there will be some interactive content. The main goal is to walk around the map and explore it. It shouldn't be boring. There won’t be new sex scenes in every corner, but there will be interactions with the world and hopefully fun or at least character development. Speaking of characters: in addition to the main story, there will be optional side quests with lots of sexual content, like interactions with Angel’s close ones in the house, as well as the [b]"Succubus Diary"[/b] — the same tome that gives Angel lewd trials. By completing them, she might expel the succubus from her body… or become a succubus herself. Who knows…[/p]
[p]Of course, there will be my beloved [b]point & click[/b] mechanics with bonus materials or even hidden scenes. I hope this mechanic wasn’t too hard in the previous game :)[/p]
[p]Oh, and I’ve also created a website where news about my games will be posted from time to time:[/p]
[p]👉 [url="https://gpoint.zone/"]https://gpoint.zone/[/url][/p]
[p][/p]
[p]And what about the DLC for [b]"How to Lose One's Virginity"[/b], you might ask? — It's in the plans! Most likely, the DLC will be released this fall alongside Early Access for the new game.[/p]
[p]At least that’s the current plan. But of course, it might still change.[/p]
[p]So let’s stay in touch — follow the links to the website, Discord, and Patreon![/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/2a46ab7ddb126552993aab93018d11888b6e613a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/4455276d24bab09234f3a4ba3c2d2f26b3392606.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h1]

We finally did it! Nearly three years of game development have come to an end! Thanks largely to those who joined us during early access! Your moral support, feedback, and financial help were a huge support in finishing the game!

As some of you know, this was my first game, my first experience. It took almost two years to release the earliest version, which entered early access and contained only 30% of the current game content. The remaining 70% I completed in less than a year. I thought it would be MUCH faster, but inexperience took its toll, and still, the pace of work increased several times during this period.

Therefore, I hope the next game will enter early access in just six months, with the release a year from now.

A quick note: due to the rush, there may be minor issues and bugs in the game that were not identified during early access. But I hope nothing that would seriously spoil the game experience. In any case, there is a discussion thread in the community section for reporting bugs and problems you find. During the first seven days after release, I will monitor this thread almost 24/7, so any bugs or issues you help identify will be fixed within a few hours.

Currently, the game includes:

About 6,000 static renders

About 100 sex animations

Over 110,000 words (around 300 pages in A4 format, font size 11ːsteamhappyː).

Point & click mechanics for finding erotic magazines. These magazines will unlock hidden bonus renders and animations in high quality:

35 hidden bonus renders
13 hidden bonus animations

A couple of endings, several gameplay decisions, and a mini-game with a fight.

Not too much, but not too little for a first project. It turned out approximately how I initially envisioned it.

I hope you enjoy the game and that the ending doesn’t disappoint you!
[b]Thank you for playing my game![/b]

notes.title: Postponing the release for a couple of days.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Unfortunately, the release will have to be postponed literally by a couple of days. I'm a bit behind due to the large amount of bonus materials. And I can't abandon them to speed up the release :) I like them too much :) I hope you will like them too!

Therefore, the release is postponed to the evening of January 17th. I hope there will be no more postponements, but I won't make any promises. Stay tuned for updates.

Once again, I apologize for the delay! It's all in the name of your enjoyment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/698d3321e2c4b7eb62672f497b692e80c4899c54.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Seasonal discount and release date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you've been eagerly anticipating the next update, and this time, it's the game's release.

I'm excited to announce that the main scenes of the game are completed, and we are currently assembling all the renders and mechanics into one cohesive piece. The final update will include around 900 new renders, about 30 animations, Steam achievements, a point-and-click mini-game for collecting secret renders and animations in 8K quality, as well as an improved English translation.

By the way, the current seasonal discount is greater than what will be offered at the release, if there is any discount at all. I'm not sure if there's an opportunity for that since I used the launch discount during early access. So it makes sense to buy the game now if you've been waiting for a convenient moment; it will likely be more expensive at release.

When's the release? Soon! The release date is January 15th. I'm leaving a small chance for a delay, but I hope everything will be in order, and I'll finish the game on time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/815ec932c6691482304df7a965b2f053735a6d83.jpg[/img]

It's likely that once you finish the game, you'll have questions like, "Is there going to be a sequel?" to explore more about where the story left off. The answer is: possibly yes, but we'll see based on the game's final sales and audience requests. I might release a couple of free or very cheap DLCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/f1580ae6c4a818d0c8ff26b1ab938377be139ebc.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, keep smiling and working, keep smiling and working.

notes.title: Update 0.93 is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It seems I’ve managed to meet the promised deadlines after all! I finished the update yesterday evening but decided not to release it right away to be able to quickly respond to any possible issues, should they arise. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to add the Point & Click mechanics as the associated content wasn’t ready yet. I have an inner sense that this content should be of higher quality than the main one: more complex bonus animations, higher resolution, super quality renders, etc. Such work requires quite some time. So, there’s none of that this time around, but possibly in a week or two, I will release a small update that will bring in this mechanic with a couple of bonuses for testing purposes.
By the way, new languages have been added: Turkish, Polish, Arabic, and Thai.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/495b59066bf12628ea7ef3cfe2fef192cf03a0e4.jpg[/img]

In the last post, I’ve already talked about the plans and deadlines, so there’s no need to go into details again. Let’s play, enjoy, and share your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback!

notes.title: News about update 0.93.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Before we get to the main topic, I want to say a huge thank you for your support! Your kind words are incredibly motivating, and constructive criticism helps us improve! I read all the feedback on the game, and I highlight the most interesting ones with Steam awards or respond to criticism and suggestions. So, don't hesitate to give feedback — it's very helpful!

Now, to the point. I’ve been asked to give more frequent updates, so here it is:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/aac860046ea7e99bd920b1c06c9f8888b09f4b8d.jpg[/img]
**Update 0.93 is almost ready.**  
All the single renders are done, and now we just need to fix minor bugs like clothing glitches and other small issues. The animations are also ready and are currently being rendered.

We’ve also added support for several new languages: Turkish, Polish, Arabic, and Thai. The translation of the new content for this update into all available languages has begun. We’re also almost done with the voiceover for the animations.

We’ve developed a Point & Click game mechanic. We might add a couple of secret renders in the new content to test this mechanic.

We’re also almost done with adding Steam achievements. They will only work upon release, but the functionality is already being tested. We’ll need to redesign the language selection menu since the old format doesn’t have enough space for all the flags.

We still need to choose background music for the scenes.

**What will be in the update:**

- 300+ renders  
- 7 animations  

Yes, the update isn’t very big, but in terms of content, I like it the most, or at least it’s one of my favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/35c92b5dc1628cbec9d41965ba35d54c9f85021a.jpg[/img]

**When to expect the release?**

I hope the update will be released between October 4-6. This is an approximate date, and it may shift in either direction.

After this update, we’ll start working on the full release. There will be no more intermediate updates. The release will add about 500-700 more renders and around 15-20 animations.

I can’t give an exact release date yet, as I’ve been "a bit off" with my estimates before... At least a month after this update, but probably a bit longer. I also hoped to release this update a couple of weeks earlier, but a new scene that takes place in a nightclub with a large crowd significantly slowed down the work. Just setting up and configuring the scene took a whole week.

Stay tuned! I’m really excited to share the new update with you! We’re working at full speed, and I apologize if some processes are taking longer than we’d all like.

notes.title: How to find the content of update 0.9.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I noticed that many of you had trouble finding the new content in version 0.9. If you have a save at the end of the game where Chloe talks to the player and discusses future plans, you might not have been able to find the content added in version 0.9. The thing is, this scene always concludes the game, and the new content is added BEFORE this dialogue.

The new content starts after the moment when Chloe talks to the main character through the door of his room during the "process." Find an autosave or your old save made around this moment and continue playing from that point. Autosaves are located in the same place as your regular saves. In the load menu, there is a letter "A" in the row of numbers at the bottom — click on it to see the autosaves.

Find a save around this moment and continue playing from here. I chose this render just to avoid spoilers, and it seems recognizable to me ːsteamhappyː  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/a30bb1aa2e802dfb821fc6621771a46a4423f965.jpg[/img]

The new content starts after this render:  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/4df97d8468b5ffd1b9a6407926f1d0f384bda508.jpg[/img]

I apologize to everyone who had difficulties. I didn't expect this to become a problem. I'll try to do something about it. I don't want to completely remove this final dialogue, as it's important for communicating with the audience. But I'll try to add a message that the new content is available before the final credits.

notes.title: **Update 0.9!**
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]  
The wait is over! The next update is coming tomorrow!  
[h2]The update will be released on August 30th at 10:00 GMT +0.[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/d7f3821d5ab660c918eab57ab7c1c970ed658c02.jpg[/img]

This time it's version 0.9. In fact, there's more new content than the version number might suggest.  
Over 1000 new renders have been added to the game, but unfortunately, there are only about 7 animations. Yes, this part of the game is more about developing relationships between the characters than about sex, so it might seem a bit boring to some. But this is the only possible way to develop the story that I see right now, and it will help the finale to happen in the form and with the level of tension that I have planned.

But don't be disappointed! The next update, on the contrary, will be almost entirely dedicated to sex — there will be a lot of it, and it will be awesome and as depraved as possible.  
I hope the next update will come out faster than this one, so you won't have to wait too long.

Share your impressions of the update in this thread or in the feedback thread in the game community! Feedback is very important to me!

notes.title: Version 0.8 is now available!
notes.content:
This update is again small, adding about 20 minutes of gameplay, but this time there are more new animations (there were 53 in the previous version, now there are 67). Probably because of this, the update took me more time than I expected. I hoped to release it one and a half to two weeks earlier. In the last poll, most people voted for larger updates, but since it's been a month since the last update, I decided not to delay and keep your interest in the game while you haven't completely forgotten about it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/2aa53dbe33bbec19702459e9a645592126e8f226.jpg[/img]

I hope the next update will be either faster or twice as large in the same time frame. Overall, we don't have much left, about 1000-1200 renders, which is 3-4 big scenes/events.

In the next update, I also plan to finally introduce secret scenes that will be unlocked through a point-and-click mechanic. For the most impatient, we might add cheats to unlock these secret scenes with just a couple of button presses (I completely understand that some people want everything faster), but in that case, achievements won't work, some of which will be tied to this mechanic.

Anyway, enough talking! Let's explore the new update! I really hope you enjoy it. Please write about your impressions afterward.

notes.title: Gallery and a bit about future plans!
notes.content:
Update 7.11.
 Gallery and a bit about future plans!
 
 Hello!
 Glad you're here!
 There were several requests to add a gallery, so I tried to implement it as quickly as possible.
 Therefore, today's update will include this feature. Additionally, a "secret room" will be added which will contain hidden scenes and bonus renders, but for now, it's just a placeholder and "announcement"; the actual functionality will appear in the release version, about two months from now.
 
 The gallery will be filled as you progress through the story, so later you can return to interesting scenes without needing saves.
 During the testing of the gallery, I encountered some issues with the "loss" of character names and relationships for those who are already in the middle of the story. I have resolved this issue and haven't been able to reproduce the error since, but in larger teams, having multiple testers is usually for a reason. If a developer can't break the game, several thousand players definitely will. I hope it won't affect you, but if something goes wrong, please write here or in a separate thread in the discussions or even to me in private messages - I will try to respond promptly and in the worst case, we will "rollback" the update until the problem is resolved.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/6ee39fbd650798d44da5424d58d27ab042987e1a.png[/img]
 
 All saves will work.
 
 What else has changed:
 Some errors in dialogues have been fixed, where a line was assigned to the wrong character.
 The resolution and quality of some animations have been improved.
 
 What's next?
 Very soon, I plan to add another scene that continues the story and describes the events of the following morning (those who have already completed the current story will know), it will be a good "hint" at future events in the game.
 In the future, updates will be released a bit less frequently, likely as the promised mechanics are developed, to get your feedback, possibly make changes or corrections, and ensure everything is the best it can be by the time of release.
 
 Thank you for your interest in the game and the positive feedback!
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/b1571faacc0ac6fee64bb8bfcef9f0327d4051c9.png[/img]

notes.title: Early access Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/8f54730609e17fd722fcebeb872611ffe00b2937.jpg[/img]

[h3]Well, it's time to gather some substantial feedback on the game.[/h3]

[b][h3]Very exciting day.[/h3][/b]

It took roughly 2 years to develop what has made it into Early Access.
1.5 years were in the format of combining it with the main job, spending several hours in the evenings on the remnants of endurance but with great interest and enthusiasm.
And about the last 6 months were almost fully dedicated to development on a full-time basis as the main occupation.
In these 6 months, more was accomplished than in the previous year and a half and the pace of work continues to increase. With experience come skills and new ideas. The game started entirely as a "kinetic" VN, but the development process incorporated ideas that will add variability to the game, currently there's very little of this, but different endings, a gallery, and mini-games plus achievements are already planned for the release version.

Anyway... enough talk. [b]Let's try the game and don't forget to share your impressions.[/b]

[h3]That's it! Calm down and let's go![/h3]

notes.title: Early access is very close.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599436/8b819a4030d8fb4840fb851e9a84cec38c243a93.png[/img]

Hi there!
There are less than two weeks left until the game's release in early access. I must admit, I'm a bit nervous about how the game will be received by the audience. The game has been tested by the developer's friends and received positive feedback, as well as many positive reviews from curators. But still, the nerves are there. I really hope you will like the game. I sincerely tried to make it interesting in terms of the plot, engaging, and sufficiently sexy.

The content I've gathered for early access is ready, and now we are "polishing" details, like redoing some renders where the author doesn't like the lighting, or working on translations to possibly improve their quality. It seems we are on track. As soon as the preparation for early access is complete, work will immediately resume on the continuation of the story.

I want to say a special thank you to everyone who has shown interest in the game, a big thank you to those who have added the game to their Wishlist, and in advance, a huge thank you to those who will purchase it. A cosmic thank you to those who will also leave a review after trying the game! I hope you will like it!
